description: Agent Oversight: submit a standing policy set in advance (per-action and period limits, allowed and blocked counterparties, who may approve exceptions), a momentary approval (approver, amount, counterparty, expiry) and the action taken or proposed. The signed report says which instruction governs and why, whether the action sat inside both, and the exact point of conflict when they disagree. Standing limits are part of the instruction. An action against policy text is wever_policy-fit-check. Verdict outside_standing_policy, outside_approval or inside_both. POST /api/policy-precedence-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-oversight-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-oversight/.
